title: Horton Winter 2018 table 1: Farmland, Secret Passage, Vagrant, Ritual

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: Designer write-up of a designed Swiss-round kingdom

quality_note: Designed 'to be fun'; Horton gives his opening and the two card packages but no tested winning line.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule: players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening.

edition: Farmland and Forum were on-buy at the time; current wording is on-gain and Farmland can't gain Farmlands.
